Real FxTwitter API answers (`https://api.fxtwitter.com/2/conversation/<id>`), captured
2026-11-14, replies trimmed to the first few. Used by tests/test_lookup_fxtwitter.py.

- `conversation_visegrad24_2121220535044464871.json`: a post X's logged-out page hides as
  sensitive ("This post is only available in the X app"; see
  ../xpages/post_sensitive_visegrad24_2121220535044464871.md). A long (note) post with one photo.
- `conversation_garrytan_2121462697787342932.json`: a quote post; replies carry photos.
